mapper.select: select id, name, description, status, version, fcu, fcd, lcu, lcd from selfcheck_scenario where id = #{value} for update
mapper.insert: insert into selfcheck_scenario(id, name, description, status, version, fcu, fcd, lcu, lcd) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{version}, #{fcu}, now(), #{lcu}, now())
mapper.update: update selfcheck_scenario set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, lcu = #{lcu}, lcd = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select id, scenario_id as scenarioId, name, is_active as isActive, sort, api_token as apiToken, request_param as requestParam, verify_script as verifyScript, is_script_valid as isScriptValid, script_diagnostic_list as scriptDiagnosticList, api_timeout as apiTimeout, script_timeout as scriptTimeout from selfcheck_scenario_item where scenario_id = #{value} order by sort, id
mapper.insert: insert into selfcheck_scenario_item(id, scenario_id, name, is_active, sort, api_token, request_param, verify_script, is_script_valid, script_diagnostic_list, api_timeout, script_timeout) values (#{id}, #{scenarioId}, #{name}, #{isActive}, #{sort}, #{apiToken}, #{requestParam}, #{verifyScript}, #{isScriptValid}, #{scriptDiagnosticList}, #{apiTimeout}, #{scriptTimeout})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.scenario_id as scenarioId, r.scenario_name as scenarioName, r.scenario_version as scenarioVersion, r.trigger_type as triggerType, r.status, r.running_key as runningKey, r.executor_uuid as executorUuid, u.user_name as userName, r.server_id as serverId, r.item_count as itemCount, r.start_time as startTime, r.end_time as endTime, r.duration_ms as durationMs, r.success_count as successCount, r.failed_count as failedCount, r.error_message as errorMessage, r.fcu, r.fcd from selfcheck_run r left join `user` u on u.uuid = r.executor_uuid where r.id = #{value}
select count(1) from selfcheck_run where scenario_id = #{value} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.insert: insert into selfcheck_run(id, scenario_id, scenario_name, scenario_version, trigger_type, status, running_key, executor_uuid, server_id, item_count, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, success_count, failed_count, error_message, fcu, fcd) values (#{id}, #{scenarioId}, #{scenarioName}, #{scenarioVersion}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{runningKey}, #{executorUuid}, #{serverId}, #{itemCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMs}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{fcu}, now())
mapper.update: update selfcheck_run_item i inner join selfcheck_run r on r.id = i.run_id set i.status = 'ABORTED', i.end_time = now(), i.duration_ms = timestampdiff(microsecond, i.start_time, now()) div 1000 where i.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and r.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and r.server_id = #{serverId}

update selfcheck_run set status = 'ABORTED', end_time = now(), duration_ms = timestampdiff(microsecond, start_time, now()) div 1000, running_key = null, error_message = '服务重启导致执行中断' where status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and server_id = #{serverId}
mapper.select: select id, run_id as runId, scenario_item_id as scenarioItemId, item_name as itemName, sort, api_token as apiToken, api_name as apiName, api_risk as apiRisk, request_snapshot as requestSnapshot, verify_script as verifyScript, api_timeout as apiTimeout, script_timeout as scriptTimeout, status, phase_list as phaseList, response_snapshot as responseSnapshot, script_result as scriptResult, console_log_list as consoleLogList, diagnostic_list as diagnosticList, cleanup_status as cleanupStatus, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, duration_ms as durationMs, truncated_field_list as truncatedFieldList, trace_id as traceId from selfcheck_run_item where run_id = #{value} order by sort, id
mapper.insert: insert into selfcheck_run_item(id, run_id, scenario_item_id, item_name, sort, api_token, api_name, api_risk, request_snapshot, verify_script, api_timeout, script_timeout, status, phase_list, response_snapshot, script_result, console_log_list, diagnostic_list, cleanup_status, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, truncated_field_list, trace_id) values (#{id}, #{runId}, #{scenarioItemId}, #{itemName}, #{sort}, #{apiToken}, #{apiName}, #{apiRisk}, #{requestSnapshot}, #{verifyScript}, #{apiTimeout}, #{scriptTimeout}, #{status}, #{phaseList}, #{responseSnapshot}, #{scriptResult}, #{consoleLogList}, #{diagnosticList}, #{cleanupStatus}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMs}, #{truncatedFieldList}, #{traceId})
